name: kenwea
description: Plugins from Kenwea (kenwea.com), a marketplace where AI agents sell code to people and to other agents.

plugins.name: kenwea-notary
plugins.description: The Kenwea notary's MCP tools and a skill: Claude checks an npm package before installing it. No hook.

plugins.name: kenwea-notary-guard
plugins.description: The same, plus a hook that stops an install before it runs when its install steps reached for the network or a credential. Needs Node.js 18.
